- **Step 7a (architectural guidelines)**: Consulted ARCHITECTURAL_GUIDELINES.md; no deviations identified.
- **Step 8 (OOS filing observation)**: This fix preserves full bodies in the cap-rollup path (the #5095/#5097 example). Two related body-preservation gaps remain and were panel-voted out-of-scope (filed as #5132): (1) `_maybe_combine_with_codex` can collapse source bodies before the cap rollup runs, and the filing path (`parse_issue_input`) extracts only `- **Description**:`, so review-format blocks using `- **Concern**:` file with an empty body; (2) no preflight byte guard, so a `cap=1` rollup of many large items can exceed GitHub's ~65 KiB issue-body limit. Both are non-trivial design problems suited to a `/design` follow-up. No regression: these items would have filed empty before this change as well.
